purpose: Defines the default notation for ADR files: file naming, file structure, optional scope box, how to rewrite rejected decisions, and the template, used when a project has no ADR format of its own.
summary: File naming rule ADR-{NNN}_{feature}.md with one ADR file per feature and a fixed number
File structure: single H1 title, numbered decision sections, fixed four subsections (context, decision, alternatives, impact)
Section numbers are never renumbered because external references depend on them
Optional scope box placed after the H1 with paired "defines" and "does not define" items
How to handle a rejected decision by rewriting the same section and moving the old option to the alternatives table
Template with guidance for writing alternatives rejection reasons and evidence-based impact
No metadata table, status history, or concrete file path listing in impact
Links to the ADR principles spec for operation, triggers and severity
tasks: Adding a decision section to an existing ADR
Rewriting a rejected or revised ADR decision
Reviewing an ADR for format compliance
Writing ADRs when no project-specific ADR format exists
title: ADR（アーキテクチャ決定記録）デフォルトフォーマット
